title.official: Summary of NATO's revised Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy

relevance.reason: NATO's revised AI strategy summary, setting out Allied political and military objectives for responsible AI adoption in defence and security. It is an internal alliance strategy, not a treaty or a binding international instrument.
ai_provisions: Whole summary — AI readiness, responsible use, principles of responsible use (PRUs), protection of AI technologies and countering adversarial AI
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-binding alliance policy; not addressed to non-NATO States and not a source of international legal obligations.

dates.notes: Original NATO AI Strategy summary published 22 October 2021; revised strategy summary published 10 July 2024.

status_note: Revised strategy adopted by NATO Allies in 2024; only the public summary is available. Non-binding.

languages.note: NATO official texts are published in English and French. The summary is an official public version, not the full classified strategy.

sources.note: Official summary of the revised AI strategy, 10 July 2024.
Official summary of the 2021 AI strategy, 22 October 2021.
